'''Junko Minagawa''' ('''皆川 純子''', ''Minagawa Junko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Minagawa was born on November 22, 1975 in {{wp|Tsuchiura}}, {{wp|Ibaraki Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She joined the {{aniseries}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where her only role was [[Charlie Charma]]. Minagawa is currently affiliated with talent agency Haikyō.
